WORKSHOP OF CARE & REPAIR REVISITED
JULY 8- AUGUST 1 in the annex
Open for Visits July 24-August 1, 2026
Schedule appointments here ​Calendar isn’t available yetYou’ll see a calendar here with available times once a service is added to it.​
Ann Schnake has built a new and different installation of The Workshop of Care and Repair, open for visits by appointment July 24-August 1. This is a listening and making site for bodies and souls, offering 1 hour sessions that begin with the premise that our needs are more common than we think; in the ferociously unstable demands of life as we know it, under this stage of capital, authoritarianism, techno-infiltration and ecologic degradation, care often = neglect. With our bodies holding the swirling poetics and metaphors of internal and external worlds, many parts within us need care and repair.
Ann Schnake is an artist, and nurse; for many years, she worked in a county clinic and offered conventional medical treatment. Now she works with more ethereal tools, making new body parts, talking with people and enacting care, repair, attention and intention. This is not therapy or medicine but old practices of ritual, listening and the work of our hands made new, all called forth in a small room of strange sculptural pieces of bodily suggestion. Here are some of the questions central to the work: What has happened to us in this moment? How do you feel? How does listening to our most tender innards prepare us for the world?
​
​In 1 hour long free sessions in a room of sculptural objects, she offers a visual site, deep listening, small makings and ritual for forming new parts and possibility.
